description: Shelf Pass — 110 prepaid credits. One payment, 110 credits ($1.10 of calls for $0.99). 1 credit = $0.01 of list price, so a $0.10 carrier check costs 10 credits and a $0.02 sanctions screen costs 2. Valid on every data shelf priced ≤ $0.25 — FX, carrier/broker/sanctions checks, Texas CE, the load-vet pack and instant Swahili localization. Redeem with the X-SHELF-PASS header — no wallet and no payment round-trip per call, which is the point for agents that check every load or counterparty. $0.99 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.
